<thought>The 13C NMR spectrum shows the following distinct chemical shift values: 168.30, 130.70, 130.27, 128.35, 126.66, 124.85, 123.57, 58.70, 36.40, and 26.40. The duplicate 36.40 indicates two carbons share the same environment, so the number of unique carbon environments equals the count of distinct shifts, which is 10.</thought>
<final_answer>10</final_answer>
